Package com.csse3200.game.entities.configs

Class TutorialConfig

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.entities.configs.TextConfig
com.csse3200.game.entities.configs.TutorialConfig
public class TutorialConfig extends TextConfig
A tutorial sequence config: a TextConfig textbox plus the input steps that advance it. Loaded by TutorialCommand from configs/tut<n>.json.

Each entry of steps pairs with the page at the same index; completing a step reveals and advances to the next page, and completing the last step dismisses the textbox.
